- Mayo Clinic: "Infant development: Birth to 3 months" (authoritative overview of early milestones)
- CDC: "Developmental Milestones | Learn the Signs. Act Early." (evidence-based milestone tracking)
- WhatToExpect: "5-Week-Old Baby: Milestones and Development" (medically reviewed developmental expectations)
- Parents.com: "Your 5-Week-Old Baby’s Milestones and Development" (pediatrician-reviewed weekly guide)

**Maternal Energy Levels (5-6 weeks postpartum):**
- PubMed: "A comparison of fatigue and energy levels at 6 weeks..." (quantitative postpartum fatigue study)
- PMC: "When fatigue postpartum is also prodromal" (NIH article defining postpartum fatigue)

- BabyCenter: "Postpartum fatigue: What it is and how to cope" (patient-oriented fatigue resource)

**Breastfeeding and Pumping Introduction (around 4-6 weeks):**
- eufy US: "When to Start Pumping: Essential Tips for New Moms" (recommends waiting 4-6 weeks to establish breastfeeding)

- PMC: "Early Breast Milk Pumping Intentions Among Postpartum Women" (research on pumping plans)

- BMJ: "Accuracy of the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS)..." (systematic review of screening tool validity)
- MDCalc: "Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) Calculator" (clinical screening tool with cutoff guidance)
